messages:
Marie (Docs): Hey team - QA flagged a docs mismatch on /generate: param `prompt` is still used in several examples but the API now expects `input`. Also response examples still show `choices` array but runtime returns `items`. Can we align and add a tiny migration snippet?
Devraj: ack. I can update the API-ref samples. Do we want the migration note to be under the endpoint or a global migration guide?
Marie (Docs): Prefer a short blurb on the endpoint + a cross-link to a migration guide. Keep it minimal: curl + JS + Go snippets. Also add a note about deprecated param alias (`prompt` -> `input`) and the timeframe for removal.
Sam - SDK: Heads up: SDK already accepts `prompt` as alias for `input` but tests expect examples to use `input`. I'll prepare updated SDK snippets and a compatibility note. Should we add an example showing the alias mapping? e.g.:
```
// JS SDK example
await redwood.generate({ model: 'rw-1', input: 'Summarize the following...' })
// old alias still works: redwood.generate({ prompt: '...' })
```
Devraj: That alias snippet is good. Also include a curl example for direct API users. I'll paste a draft: 
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model":"rw-1","input":"Explain quantum entanglement in 2 sentences."}'
```
Alex (API): FYI the backend change that landed last week changed body shape for streaming vs sync responses. For sync we now return `items` (array of objects with `text` and `metadata`) instead of `choices`. Make sure examples reflect both shapes and call out the difference with an explicit header: `X-Response-Format: legacy|v2`.
Marie (Docs): Good point. Let's show both examples with a clear caption: `Legacy response (choices)` and `Current response (items)` and a short note about `X-Response-Format` header. Also add a tiny code sample showing how to map old responses to new in JS: 
```
// compatibility shim
function mapResponse(resp) {
  if (resp.choices) return resp.choices.map(c => ({ text: c.text }));
  return resp.items;
}
```
Chris (PM): Can we add the deprecation window: alias supported for 3 months then 30-day removal notice? Also want a changelog line for the public release.
Marie (Docs): Yes - propose: "Prompt param alias will be supported until 2026-06-30; after that clients must use `input`. We'll post a 30-day removal notice before disabling." Anyone object?
Sam - SDK: LGTM. I'll add a test case for alias and update the README snippet.
Devraj: I'll update the OpenAPI examples and the inline example JSON in the docs site. Will open a PR and tag @Sam and @Marie for review.
Marie (Docs): Thanks — can you also add `deprecated` badges on the old examples and a redirect note? small checklist for the PR: 1) update curl/JS/Go snippets 2) add response examples for legacy & v2 3) migration note + header explanation 4) changelog entry 5) update SDK snippets and tests.
Devraj: On it. Draft PR -> #3421 when ready.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: docs-tooling-preview -> live at 2026-03-14T09:00:00Z :rocket:
Alex (API): One last nit — update the code sample in the quickstart where we call `response.choices[0].text` to use the shim or `response.items[0].text` depending on header. I'll comment on the PR with exact line numbers.
Marie (Docs): Perfect. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
